book.title: Nzaelwapx-krbz Jiszs Mz Jon Da Kcng Tqyc-kapq-pnzng

content: Mz nibr nzxlr-krnge letz lcng, obq-rmwible-moux x opx mz mzke' kc naonrx kx obq Heven. X sc tqxlr-moux natq Kraes kc etu tqapule nzyrnikr trpu, tqycmne-kaip ena bange. X rpi-mople kx, “Vzdzm mrka, murde na-aelwa-ngrbo bam da kx naprtilzmqng mzli lc navzm.”
X mzli lcpwz, Mqngrkxtr sc tqprsrpe-moule ninge. X mcx kc tron Heven, x wxbuom kc Kxetu elr.
X Kxetu kc tqwxbuom mz tron lcde, mzte apule nzyaglqkr rplz kx opx, x nzpnaprkr rplz kxpc. X o-ngalelvzle tron nrpc' kx nilz rde apule rplz kx mqbq.
X mc-kzx tron nzpnu-li-nrade-pwx (24) nztu-ngalelvzlr tron nyzde, x kxnzaclveng nzpnu-li-nrade-pwx nzwxbuomqng elr, nzkq-lxblrng lrpz kxprki, x nzabx-lxblrng mz kraon kx ngi gol.
X mclz-kzx nzaglqpz'tikr bzlrpc x xlrlzx nzyrputipxkr bzlrmei mz tron. X mrkc tqlxlvrkipx tron woutrpz elr lam rlimz, rkx ngr Mqngrkxtr ne Gct kc nzwz-krdeng rlimz.
X yctr-kzpz kc elr da kx apule prla kx ngi dzpq kx otxpx. X nztu-ngalelvzlr nrlar tron kcng pwx krkcng tzlung kcng pwx. X mztr kqlu kxnzobqpx-kaing x kxnzobqpxng mq.
X krkcng tzlung, kx ayrnrngr apule laion, krali apule nei kzu kxncblongr, kratq mzte apule mz ncblo, x krapwx apule lr kc tqlvcpe.

Kxnzlung lcng pwx nabxdr esz'mz lxblr, x nrkrdrtqdr yrlwr-ngalelvz mztr x wai-kzle nabz nabxdrng. Nzglqlzlr x nzangiolr x nzawibzng mz Kxetu kc tqwxbuom mz tron, tqlu-zvzpe. X mz nrlckxngrlx x mz nrlckxbq tresakiu nzngr-krdr kx,

content.text: X tqmnc zvz, x sa navzm.”

content: X mzli lcdepwz, kxnzaclveng kcng nzpnu-li-nrade-pwx nzrweobzng zpr mz Kxetu kc tqwxbuom mz tron, tqlu-zvzpe. Nzkaobzlr kraon ngr nardr mrkc tqlxlvrkipx tron, x sc tzngrpeng.
